name: Wanderburg — Isometric 3D
description: The same valley through a parameterized ORTHOGRAPHIC lens: a fixed 45° azimuth and elevation, no perspective foreshortening, the mountain ring reads as a clean circle. A working alternative look, not a migration target — meshes, toon bands and ink edges are unchanged; only the projection and the framing differ. Every entity is SELF-PRESENTED (GAME_SPEC.entities declare representation "none"): js/WanderView.js + js/WanderMesh.js build the meshes on the kit engine layer, so the pipeline binds no second copy of anything.
